title: Choroidal Response to Novel Spectacle Lens to Control Myopia Progression
brief_summary: Diurnal variations in the thickness of the choroid have been reported in the literature, and, more recently, the role of the choroid has been studied with respect to its role in myopia (near-sightedness) progression.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participating in the CPRO-1802-001 (Cypress\_SG) study at CORE
* Read and signed an Assent and their parent/guardian has signed an information consent letter

Exclusion Criteria:

* Transient health condition which may affect the eye(s) (e.g. a common cold, active allergies, fatigue, etc;)
